question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a linear slot diffuser in place of the specified perforated face diffuser per Section 23 82 00, citing lead-time concerns.
proposed_solution: Substitute a linear slot alternate diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser.
deadline_text: A response within three business days would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: Since this substitution request has no cost impact, it defaults to the Mechanical Engineer as the design professional of record for HVAC diffuser specifications.
